name: Monday.com
description: Project management: Work OS platform for boards, items, workflows, docs and CRM-style project tracking.
access_notes: Admin/member users on any plan (including free and free no-expiry developer sandbox accounts) can copy a personal API token from the Developers section; free/trial plans are capped at 200 daily API calls. OAuth apps are built self-serve in the Developer Center (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE rolled out platform-wide). Viewers/student accounts cannot access the API.
mcp_notes: Official hosted Platform MCP server at https://mcp.monday.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP; OAuth 2.0 or Bearer API token; ~60+ tools; maintained by monday.com AI team, open-source repo github.com/mondaycom/mcp). Separate Apps MCP exists for the apps framework. Composio also lists a monday toolkit (composio.dev/toolkits/monday).
uncertainty_notes: Daily API call limits are low on free/trial plans (200 calls/day); paid plans get more.

evidence.note: GraphQL API at https://api.monday.com/v2; access token sent in the Authorization header.
OAuth2 authorization code flow via auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize for monday apps.
Admin, member and guest users can use the API; admins and members have their own API tokens; viewers/student accounts cannot.
Free, no-expiration developer/sandbox account available self-serve for API and app development.
Official hosted Platform MCP server at https://mcp.monday.com/mcp maintained by the monday.com AI team.
monday.com's official GitHub org hosts the open-source MCP server package, confirming vendor ownership.
